summary: The commit-bound evidence covers raw images, probability heads, filled masks, instance boundaries, centerlines, final overlays, and stratified tracking examples for KJ-01 and WT-01. However, the tracking panels show centerlines only, not filled masks or instance boundaries, so the required assessment of merges, false splits, and boundary leakage across planes—especially for touching and irregular cases—is not possible. The segmentation-stage comparison is also limited to one Z plane per specimen. These gaps block visual-evidence acceptance of the broad production claim.

findings.title: Tracking evidence cannot reveal merge, split, or boundary errors
findings.impact: A stable colored centerline can look correct even when its filled instance mask leaks into a neighbor, excludes part of the nucleus, or represents an erroneous merge or split. Therefore the touching, irregular, and other cross-plane examples do not establish visually truthful instance geometry.
evidence: scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:114-125 overlays centerline labels only.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:188-214 shows raw planes or centerline overlays without filled masks, instance boundaries, or probability support.
audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json:138-155 and 309-327 designate touching tracks but provide no mask/boundary evidence.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the stratified tracking evidence with identical-frame raw, probability support, filled target and neighboring masks, instance boundaries, centerline, and final track overlay for every displayed plane. Preserve an unobscured raw panel and distinguish target and neighboring identities.

findings.title: Segmentation failure assessment is restricted to two single-plane examples
findings.impact: One Z35 field from each of two specimens cannot demonstrate that missed nuclei, leakage, merges, and false splits were examined across focus, intensity, morphology, and stack position for a production-wide claim.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:6-52 lists only KJ-01 Z35 and WT-01 Z35.
audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/end_to_end/end_to_end_visual_evidence_manifest.json:7-31 contains only one segmentation-stage artifact and one tracking artifact per specimen.
findings.recommendation: Add commit-bound, matched-frame stage panels for explicitly selected faint, bright, curved, short, long, touching, and irregular detections across multiple Z positions, including documented difficult and known-failure examples.

findings.title: Crop integrity and example representativeness are undocumented
findings.impact: A crop may omit a relevant neighbor or truncate an edge object, and selecting metric extrema does not establish that examples are representative rather than exceptional.
evidence: scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:61-99 selects category extrema without a representativeness criterion.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:104-111 clips crops to image dimensions but records no edge-contact or neighbor-inclusion status.
audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json:13-356 records selected tracks and metrics but no crop coordinates, edge flags, or selection-pool ranks.
findings.recommendation: Record crop bounds, source dimensions, edge-contact flags, selection-pool sizes and ranks, and a rationale distinguishing representative examples from deliberately adversarial extrema.

limitations: The repository commits the consolidated four-page PDF but not the source stage and tracking PNG files named by the manifests; artifact-level reinspection is therefore limited to the PDF rasterization.
No full image stack was run, as required by the review instructions.
This review did not inspect other reviewers' outputs.
recommended_follow_up: Create a superseding visual-evidence package containing per-plane masks, boundaries, probability support, centerlines, and track overlays at identical framing for all morphology strata.
Include explicit examples of missed detections, merges, false splits, boundary leakage, crop-edge cases, and correctly rejected joins.
Run a new independent visual_evidence review against the superseding commit-bound package.
